scientific_integrity: Explicit infinite proof by forests and independent displacement constraints; exhaustive finite checks through n=9 are corroboration, not proof of the asymptotic limit.
scientific_limitations: Order-preserving partial translations on chains only. Exact full commuting-pair count and optimal exponential rate not claimed; possible implicit priority in uninspected literature.
title: Exponential convergence to one-ninth commutativity for finite-chain partial translations
